replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello _Eth,

Sorry for the wait, but after considering all the facts and the opinions of the seniors i've asked, i have decided to deny this appeal. The main reason for this decision was because of a number of chat logs that indicated that you were him. Now you claim that it is was your neighbour, but i honestly doubt that after checking your chat logs. The main chat log that caught my attention was when you told someone that they could expose you, but they cannot name the alts. Honestly i've done my best to try to make it as fair as possible but all you have is "It's my neighbour" against my evidence, the chat logs. You have no solid evidence to back what you are saying up. On top of that, i highly suggest in the future, on any minecraft server, you do not threaten to ddos any of the staff or players that report you. Whether you did it on Avicus or on skype it does not matter, it shows me that i cannot trust you and what you are saying.

Regards, 

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
